title: What if De Bruyne joined Bayern?
checked: Born 28 June 1991 (22 in Jan 2014); Wolfsburg 18 Jan 2014, about £18m (Wikipedia). 2014-15: 10 league goals, 21 assists, Bundesliga record (Wikipedia, SI); 2015 German Footballer of the Year, scored in the 3-1 Pokal final v Dortmund (Wikipedia). Bayern interest per his agent, Bayern pulled out, PSG also interested (ESPN, CaughtOffside). City 30 Aug 2015, six-year deal, club record about £54-55m (Wikipedia, ESPN, CaughtOffside). Pep at Bayern 2013-16, City from 2016 (general record). 20 assists 2019-20 equalling Henry (Wikipedia). 6 PL, 5 League Cups, 2 FA Cups, 1 UCL (Wikipedia). 108 goals, 177 assists (Gulf News; NBC 106/174 before his last games). Napoli June 2025 (Wikipedia). The old 'personal terms with Bayern' claim was not confirmed: removed.

lines.text: Chelsea let him go. Bayern wanted him. City paid a club record to get him.
January 2014. José Mourinho's Chelsea sell a twenty-two-year-old Belgian to Wolfsburg.
lines.say: January, twenty fourteen. Hozay Moreenyo's Chelsea sell a twenty-two-year-old Belgian to Volfsburg.

scene.headline: Chelsea sell De Bruyne to Wolfsburg
scene.standfirst: The Belgian leaves Stamford Bridge for about £18m after few chances under José Mourinho.

lines.text: In Germany, he explodes. Ten league goals, and twenty-one assists. A Bundesliga record.
Germany's Footballer of the Year. And a goal in the cup final win over Dortmund.
Summer 2015. The big clubs come calling. His agent later said Bayern Munich wanted him.
lines.say: Summer, twenty fifteen. The big clubs come calling. His agent later said Bayern Munich wanted him.

scene.headline: Bayern wanted De Bruyne, says agent
scene.standfirst: The Bundesliga champions were interested before he chose Manchester City. Paris Saint-Germain were in the race too.

lines.text: And Bayern's coach at the time? Pep Guardiola.
lines.say: And Bayern's coach at the time? Pep Gwardeeohlah.

lines.text: But Bayern back off. City pay a club record, around fifty-five million pounds.
lines.say: But Bayern back off. City pay a club record, around fifty-five million pounds.

lines.text: Now flip it. Bayern pay up, and De Bruyne plays for Pep in Munich.
lines.say: Now flip it. Bayern pay up, and Duh Broynuh plays for Pep in Munich.

lines.text: One year later, Pep leaves for City. His best playmaker stays behind in Germany.
In the real world, he ran Pep's City. Twenty assists in 2019-20, equalling Henry's record.
lines.say: In the real world, he ran Pep's City. Twenty assists in twenty nineteen, twenty, equalling Onree's record.

scene.title: Most assists in a season
scene.note: Both on 20: the joint Premier League record

lines.text: Six league titles, five League Cups, two FA Cups, and the Champions League.
One hundred and eight goals, one hundred and seventy-seven assists. Then, in 2025, Napoli.
lines.say: One hundred and eight goals, one hundred and seventy-seven assists. Then, in twenty twenty-five, Nappolee.

lines.text: Bayern let him slip. City built a dynasty around him.
lines.say: Bayern let him slip. City built a dynasty around him.
